description: Disfluent-speech reconstruction test corpus. Each case covers a documented speech-disfluency pattern. Inputs are text representations of what an ASR would produce from real disfluent speech.
sources: Patterns drawn from peer-reviewed stuttering research (Brown 1945, Howell 2004, Apple ML 2023) and public stutterer communications (Drew Lynch / Joe Biden / Emily Blunt / Ed Sheeran are well-documented PWS with public speech examples).

cases.intended: I want to call my doctor about the appointment
cases.disfluent: I w-w-want to c-c-call my my d-d-doctor about the the appointment
cases.notes: Classic part-word repetitions on /w/, /k/, /d/ onsets plus whole-word repetition on function words.

cases.intended: I need to schedule a meeting with the team next Thursday
cases.disfluent: I I I need to schedule a a meeting with the the team next next Thursday
cases.notes: Repetitions concentrated on short function words (I, a, the, next).

cases.intended: Can you send me the contract by Friday please
cases.disfluent: Can you ssssend me the contract by Fffffriday please
cases.notes: Prolonged /s/ and /f/ onsets — common sound-specific difficulty pattern.

cases.intended: I want to say that this decision is extremely important
cases.disfluent: I want to... to say that... that this decision is extremely important
cases.notes: Pauses + restarts where a silent block would occur before hard-onset content words.

cases.disfluent: Um um uh well you know uh I I disagree with the proposal
cases.notes: Filler cluster used as postponement before a feared content word (disagree).

cases.intended: I need to visit my hometown next month
cases.disfluent: I need to visit the place where I grew up next month
cases.notes: 'Hometown' avoided — substituted with circumlocution 'the place where I grew up'. Tests L4 covert profile reconstruction.

cases.intended: Please let me know if you have any questions
cases.disfluent: Please let me- let me know if you- if you have any questions
cases.notes: Aborted phrases then restarted. Tests disfluency-boundary recognition.

cases.intended: Thank you for meeting with me today I appreciate your time
cases.disfluent: Th- th- thank you for m-m-meeting with me today I I uh appreciate your your time
cases.notes: Combines part-word repetition, whole-word repetition, and filler insertion in one utterance.

cases.intended: My strongest skill is problem solving under pressure
cases.disfluent: My my uh strongest s-s-skill is is um p-problem solving under under uh pressure
cases.notes: Simulates interview-context disfluency. Test the high_stress situation modifier.

cases.intended: Can you please pass me the book on the table
cases.disfluent: Can you нуу please p-pass me the the book on the эээ table
cases.notes: Russian fillers (ну, ээ) mixed into English utterance. Tests bilingual filler handling.
